description: Hand-maintained role labels for X3AP.exe function starts (preferred VAs, image base 0x00400000). Only addresses and short roles copied from the reverse-engineering notes; `hooked_apis` lists the instrumented imports the documented function is known to call so a sampled function can be set next to its hooked time.
